title: Application login
story: As a registered user, I want to log into the application so that I can access the overview page.
acceptance_criteria: Overview page appears||Logout option appears in the upper bar on the right

title: Change of user's personal data
story: As a logged in user, I want to change my personal data so that my profile information is updated.
acceptance_criteria: User is still on the Overview page||Message confirming successful execution appears
